excerpt: Wiz is a cloud and AI security platform, now part of Google Cloud after a $32 billion acquisition. What it does, how it is priced, and alternatives.
content:
Wiz is a cloud security company. Its platform connects to an organisation's cloud accounts and code environments and, in Google's words, secures everything organisations build and run in the cloud. Wiz now calls it a Cloud and AI Security Platform, covering AI systems as well as ordinary cloud workloads. Google describes Wiz as a platform that connects to all major clouds and code environments, and Wiz says its products keep working across Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure and Oracle Cloud. Assaf Rappaport is Wiz's co-founder and CEO.

Google's acquisition

On 18 March 2025 Google announced an agreement to buy Wiz, then headquartered in New York, for $32 billion in cash, subject to closing adjustments. Google said on 11 March 2026 that it had completed the acquisition. Wiz has joined Google Cloud but keeps its own brand, and Google said Wiz products would continue to be available on all major clouds, not only its own. Google Cloud said it will offer an AI-powered security platform that combines Google's Threat Intelligence and Security Operations with Wiz's Cloud and AI Security Platform.

In a post on 29 July 2026 looking back at six months inside Google, Rappaport wrote that about 90% of Wiz customers use its AI-powered security features, that the Wiz Integration Network now has 300 integrations, and that AI Threat Defense, which combines Wiz, Mandiant and Google DeepMind, had launched with Google.

Pricing

Wiz does not publish prices. Its pricing page names three ways to buy, Wiz One, Wiz Go and À la Carte, and asks you to fill in a form for a custom quote. Expect a sales process rather than self-serve sign-up.

Who it is for

Wiz is built for security and cloud teams at companies running significant workloads in one or more public clouds, especially those that use several clouds at once and want a single view of risk across them. Very small teams with a single cloud account may find the cloud provider's own security tools enough to start with.

We have not tested Wiz ourselves. This page brings together Wiz's official site, its own announcements and reputable news coverage, plus the public pages of the products it is compared with, and says where each fact comes from.
